show_pixels.label: Show pixel size on tiled windows
show_pixels.description: Append the tiled window's new size in pixels to the percentage (floating windows always show pixels)

include_floating.label: Include floating windows
include_floating.description: Also show the popup (in pixels) when a floating window is resized

gap.label: Layout gap
gap.description: Umbriel layout.gap in pixels, used to turn window sizes into extent fractions

min_change_px.label: Minimum change
min_change_px.description: Ignore size changes smaller than this many pixels

combine_window_ms.label: Combine axes window (ms)
combine_window_ms.description: When width and height both change within this many milliseconds (e.g. a corner drag), keep showing both instead of flickering between them. 0 disables
